# Spectralizer

> FFT spectrum analyzer: browser app, Windows desktop, and VST3/CLAP plugin.

- Site: https://grishinskeo-ship-it.github.io/
- Web app: https://grishinskeo-ship-it.github.io/app/
- Docs index for models: https://grishinskeo-ship-it.github.io/llms.txt
- Full dump: https://grishinskeo-ship-it.github.io/llms-full.txt
- Releases: https://github.com/grishinskeo-ship-it/Spectralizer/releases/tag/v1.0.0
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later

## Code

- `src/` React UI and Web Audio / fft.js analyzer (desktop + web)
- `electron/` thin BrowserWindow, no Node in renderer
- `vst/` Rust NIH-plug VST3/CLAP
- `docs/` GitHub Pages site
